text: The Computer Science Minor prerequisite flowchart includes the following courses: CS 1336/1136 Programming Fundamentals; CS/CE 1337 Computer Science I; CS/CE 2336 Computer Science II; CS/CE/TE 2305 Discrete Math I; CS 3305 Discrete Math II; CS/CE/SE/TE 3345 Data Structures & Algorithms; CS/CE/SE 3354 Software Engineering; CS/SE 3341 Probability & Statistics in CS; ECS 3390 Professional & Technical Communication; RHET 1302 Rhetoric; MATH 2413 Differential Calculus; MATH 2414 Integral Calculus; MATH 2417 Calculus I; MATH 2419 Calculus II; and any CS 43xx or CS 4390. CS 1336 is required of students with no prior programming experience and is not for credit in ECS (Erik Jonsson School of Engineering and Computer Science). A grade of C or better is needed in prerequisite courses. Entry into the calculus sequence requires a score of at least 75% in ALEKS or MATH 2312 with a grade of C or better. Junior standing is also listed as a requirement in the chart. The chart distinguishes between courses that are prerequisites and those that may be taken as pre- or co-requisites.
